units.source_text: “我现在回想，这真是一个可以委托一切的贤妻。

en.t: When I think back on it now, she truly was a wise wife to whom one could entrust everything.

units.source_text: 无论琐屑之事或重大之事，同她商量，她总有高明见解。

en.t: Whether the matter was trivial or important, whenever I consulted her, she always had excellent judgment.

units.source_text: 此外，讲到洗染，她的本领不亚于装点秋林的立田姬[\[8\]](#part1331.html#m8)。

en.t: Moreover, when it came to washing and dyeing, her skill was no less than that of Princess Tatsuta, who adorns the autumn woods[\[8\]](#part1331.html#m8).

units.source_text: 讲到缝纫，她的妙手不劣于银河岸边的织女姬。

en.t: As for sewing, her clever hands were in no way inferior to those of the Weaver Maiden by the banks of the Milky Way.

units.source_text: 在这些方面她也是全才呢。”

en.t: In these respects as well, she was a woman of every talent.
